scope: Future car occupancy and anticipatory restriction of current evidence-supported road candidates; not full future freespace reconstruction
limits: Previously inspected validation set, not blind
GRU trained on 560 scenes, selected on 140; tracker penalty previously tuned on val
Road task log isolation does not remove detection pretraining exposure
Current car-blocked/unknown regions remain blocked/unknown even if cars leave
Instantaneous occupancy, not swept path, ego planning, collision avoidance or safety certification
Constant box yaw can misrepresent turning vehicles
Only cars receive motion prediction; other future actors evaluated as an additional limitation
Free means no annotated actor plus current ground evidence, not verified future physical free space
